rows.grounds: past passive participle indicating what is stated
loci described as limbs or parts
cardinal or spatial directions as loci
connects the two sets of loci

items.question: In which limbs and directions is Rudra declared to be present?
premises: Rudra is the subject being declared.
The limbs are named as loci of Rudra.
The directions are named as loci of Rudra.
items.inference: Rudra is declared to be present in both the limbs and the directions.
uncertainties: Whether aṅgeṣu refers to bodily limbs or ritual-mantric parts is not specified.
items.plain_english: Rudra is declared to be present in the limbs and in the directions.
